## Task / 使用任务

What are you trying to accomplish, and where does the current workflow fall short?

## Context / 补充信息

Which purchase channel, app version, image formats or batch sizes are relevant? Check existing issues before posting. Do not include private client material, receipts or credentials. Submitting a request does not promise implementation or a release date.
